# The Pair

> Two pages, so a translation has something to mirror.

A community documentation of com.example/subject, published by com.example.docs, in en.
Read it at /doc/com.example.docs/pair/0.1.0/. Rendered 2026-09-12.

What it covers: two pages, one with an example and a section, one with a list.
For whom: whoever changes the translation check and needs a source to check against.
What it assumes known: nothing; it documents nothing real.
What it leaves out: everything else.
